name: datadog
description: Connect Datadog to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Datadog MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Datadog to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with monitoring, logs and traces using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Datadog workspace.
Find anything in Datadog that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review monitoring, logs and traces in Datadog.
